name: zzbd_manager_request_stop
description: zZbdManager::RequestStop sets the cooperative stopRequested flag.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and disassembly at 0x4c0620 show a single store of 1 to self->stopRequested at offset 0x30.
The native request-stop smoke verifies the direct manager method sets stopRequested to 1.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4c0620 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
